title: Sample deck
description: Placeholder deck so the game has something to play. Replace it with sentences from your book.

sentences.en: I have been meaning to ask you about that.
sentences.note: have been meaning to = 계속 ~하려고 생각해 왔다

sentences.en: It took me a while to get used to the noise.
sentences.ko: 그 소음에 익숙해지는 데 시간이 좀 걸렸어.

sentences.en: You might as well tell her the truth.
There is no point in arguing with him.
sentences.ko: 그와 다퉈 봐야 아무 소용이 없어.

sentences.en: I would rather stay home than go out tonight.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤에는 나가는 것보다 집에 있는 게 좋겠어.

sentences.en: She is the last person I expected to see here.
sentences.ko: 그녀는 내가 여기서 볼 거라고 전혀 예상하지 못한 사람이야.
sentences.note: the last person = 가장 ~할 것 같지 않은 사람

sentences.en: Let me know as soon as you hear back from them.
sentences.ko: 그들에게서 답을 받는 대로 나에게 알려 줘.

sentences.en: I am not sure whether it is worth the trouble.
sentences.ko: 그게 그런 수고를 할 만한 가치가 있는지 잘 모르겠어.
sentences.note: worth the trouble = 수고할 만한 가치가 있다

sentences.en: He ended up doing all the work by himself.
sentences.ko: 그는 결국 모든 일을 혼자서 하게 되었어.

sentences.en: Now that you mention it, I do remember her name.
sentences.ko: 네가 그 말을 하니까, 그녀의 이름이 정말 기억나네.
